title: Inline Agent Editing, Multi-Harness Dispatch & Selection Navigation
summary: Introduces selection-anchored inline editing powered by external coding harnesses (OpenCode, Codex, Aider, Goose, Claude, Gemini, Cursor, and Antigravity) with worktree snapshots, one-click undo, keyboard text selection, and UI refinements.

categories.name: Inline Agent Editing & Coding Harnesses
items: Dispatch selection-anchored inline edits directly from the source editor or diff view using Alt+E (Option+E on macOS)
Preset integrations and dynamic model discovery for OpenCode, OpenAI Codex, Aider, and Goose alongside Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Cursor Agent, and Antigravity
Automatic working-tree snapshotting with instant one-click or keyboard undo support for agent-modified files
In-box model switcher dropdown and persistent harness preferences across editing sessions
Live terminal process output streaming with duration timing, changed file counts, and in-box cancellation (Escape)
Automatic tab reloading, LSP document refresh, and syntax cache clearing when agent runs complete
Preserve active editor selection highlights, tab diff mode, and scroll position during agent composition and reload
Display detailed stdout and stderr error output in the composer when an agent run fails or is interrupted

categories.name: Editor Selection & Navigation
items: Full keyboard text selection navigation using Shift+Arrows for line and character selection and Shift+Ctrl/Option+Arrows for word jumps
Synchronize DOM selection ranges with cursor position and virtualized editor rendering
Immediate footer selection action bar and right-click context menu offering Edit Inline, Copy Ref, Copy with Context, and Find Usages
Selection range mapping and preservation across diff views and background workspace reloads
Permanently visible line numbers in the editor viewport

categories.name: UI Styling & Polish
items: GitHub Dark is now the default theme with seamless active tab surface styling
Redesigned floating toast notifications featuring a modern blurred pill aesthetic and semantic status colors
New 'Copy Ref' action for copying clean @path:l1-l2 citations and 'Copy with Context' for prompt-ready snippet blocks
Native process metrics popup in the status bar for real-time CPU and RAM monitoring
Streamlined status bar layout with right-aligned selection range statistics and dedicated 'Find in File' footer action
Refined hovercards, command palette borders, and modal keycap styling

categories.name: CLI & Developer Experience
items: Display all detected coding harnesses on startup in the CLI banner
Added -verbose CLI flag for inspecting request timings, prompt payloads, and agent job identifiers
Added OpenCode and Codex binary directories (~/.local/bin, /usr/local/bin) to default search paths
Refactored documentation with remote read-first guides, agent editing workflows, and architecture notes
Fixed frontend identifier collisions under Node.js bundler fallback environments
